methodology: Entries are compiled from public, non-sponsored sources: legal directories (Lawzana, Advocate Abroad), firm track record with international buyers, and English-language capability. No entry is a paid placement and none has any relationship with this app. Always verify independence: your lawyer must NOT be recommended by, or share fees with, the selling agent or developer. Treat this list as a starting shortlist, not an endorsement.
disclaimer: Recommendations are informational only. Interview at least two professionals per role, ask for references from past foreign clients, and confirm bar/registry membership before engaging.

professionals.name: LexSofia
professionals.specialty: Real estate acquisition, due diligence and immigration for foreign buyers
professionals.why_recommended: Sofia-based firm with a long-standing dedicated foreign-buyer real estate practice; publishes detailed English-language guidance on Bulgarian property law.

professionals.name: Advocate Abroad - vetted Sofia property lawyers
professionals.specialty: Property purchase representation, escrow and title checks
professionals.why_recommended: Directory that pre-vets English-speaking lawyers and publishes verified client reviews - a useful unbiased cross-check against any single firm's marketing.

professionals.name: Sofia Property Broker
professionals.specialty: Buyer-side brokerage focused on central Sofia districts
professionals.why_recommended: Positions itself as an independent, buyer-side agent not tied to developer stock - the key independence test for a realtor in a market dominated by listing-side agencies.

professionals.name: Bulgarian Properties
professionals.specialty: Largest national listing coverage incl. Sofia new-builds
professionals.why_recommended: Broadest inventory in the country - useful for price discovery and comparables even if you transact through a buyer-side agent.

professionals.name: Varnavas Law Firm
professionals.specialty: Real estate acquisitions for foreign investors; Golden Visa department since 2013
professionals.why_recommended: 40+ year real estate practice with a core focus on representing foreign buyers; consistently positive independent client reviews citing experience and responsiveness.

professionals.name: Lawzana - top-rated Athens real estate lawyers
professionals.why_recommended: Aggregates verified client reviews across Athens real-estate lawyers - the most neutral starting point for building a shortlist and cross-checking any referral.

professionals.name: Spitogatos / Spiti360 listings + independent buyer's agent
professionals.specialty: Spitogatos is Greece's dominant listing portal - use it for unbiased price discovery
professionals.why_recommended: In Athens most agencies represent sellers. The unbiased route: research prices yourself on the dominant portal, then engage a fee-based buyer's agent rather than relying on a seller's agent's advice.

professionals.name: Palmigiano Law Firm (Palermo)
professionals.specialty: Independent real estate advice for international clients
professionals.why_recommended: Established Palermo firm (founded 1954) that explicitly offers independent buyer-side advice in English - independence from the agent/notary chain is the critical safeguard in Italian transactions.

professionals.name: Dimarco & Partners (Catania)
professionals.specialty: Property and corporate law for foreign individuals in eastern Sicily
professionals.why_recommended: English-speaking Catania firm serving foreign buyers - relevant if you target the Catania/Etna Valley listings.

professionals.name: Property in Sicily
professionals.specialty: International-buyer agency covering the whole island incl. post-purchase support
professionals.why_recommended: Long-running agency specialised in foreign buyers with post-purchase renovation support; cross-check any listing price on Immobiliare.it before offering.

professionals.name: Immobiliare.it (portal) + local geometra for survey
professionals.specialty: Italy's dominant listing portal for unbiased price discovery
professionals.why_recommended: Use the portal for comparables and always commission an independent geometra/surveyor - Sicilian historic stock frequently has cadastral irregularities that a seller's agent will not volunteer.
